meta.name: tam-sam-som-calculator
meta.description: Calculate TAM, SAM, and SOM with explicit assumptions, methods, and caveats. Use when sizing a market for a product idea, business case, or executive review.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算市场规模，支撑产品决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要估算产品市场机会并量化业务假设
copy.tagline_en: Calculate market size to support product decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to estimate product market opportunity and quantify business assumptions

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你逐步计算 TAM、SAM 和 SOM，通过提问收集产品信息、地理区域、行业和客户数据，最终生成带引用的市场分析报告。
howto.when: 当你需要估算某个产品创意的市场规模，例如准备商业计划、投资者演示或产品验证时，可以触发该技能。

say.text: 帮我估算美国牙科诊所AI排程工具的市场规模，月费99美元。
say.note: Claude 会启动市场计算流程，逐步提问。

say.text: 用研究模式计算DACH区域现场服务调度软件的市场。
say.note: Claude 会自主搜索数据并构建自下而上的估算。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through calculating TAM, SAM, and SOM by asking questions about product idea, geography, industry, and customers, then generates a structured analysis with citations.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need to size a market for a product idea, business case, or executive review, e.g., for investor pitches or product validation.

say_en.text: Size the market for an AI scheduling assistant for US dental practices at $99/month.
say_en.note: Claude starts the market sizing flow with guided questions.

say_en.text: Research-mode market sizing for field-service dispatch software in DACH region.
say_en.note: Claude autonomously researches and builds a bottom-up estimate.
